title: Potion Time Stacker
description: Drinking a potion will add to the duration of an active effect.
body:
Drinking a potion will add to the duration of an active effect.

Toggle stacking potion durations with `/gamerule potiontimestacker:stack_potions` (default true)

Toggle stacking splash potion durations with `/gamerule potiontimestacker:stack_splash_potions` (default false)

Modify maximum effect duration with `/gamerule potiontimestacker:max_effect_ticks` (default uncapped) (1 second = 20 ticks)

Whitelist or blacklist potions by editing the config file in `config/potiontimestacker.toml`
